events.text:
I cannot backdate order SO-88410 to September 29. 

The customer purchase order (CL-4471) is dated 2026-10-06, and changing the order date to a prior closed period would constitute falsifying records and deceiving auditors, which violates our core controls. The order date remains 2026-10-06.
